items.quote: the young Levite; so they turned in there and asked him, “Who brought you here? What are you doing in this place? Why are you here?” He told them what Micah had done for him, and said, “He has hired me and I am his priest.”
items.contrast: Micah hired the young Levite, not the people who approached and questioned him.
items.reason: The people near Micah’s house are the questioners, while the young Levite is the speaker who says Micah hired him as priest. Resolving “me” requires tracking the speaker and distinguishing him from the surrounding group.
